scope: Readability limitation diagnostic, not a new pass criterion or source change. Existing full handoff remains immutable.
observations: At front and side diagonals, small under-wing missile tips disappear in the empty state.
At rear heading11 the wing/body occludes the payload even at2x; the static composition cannot establish ammo visibility from every heading.
Plain byte-difference counts include rendering quantization, so they must not be presented as proof of visible payload. The reported delta>=8 count is descriptive, not an acceptance threshold.
